title: Adaptive conformal prediction on the Grassmannian
abstract: arXiv:2610.23508v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce a conformal prediction framework for regression with Grassmann-valued responses. The proposed method constructs prediction regions in the form of metric balls directly on the Grassmann manifold, using basis-invariant geometric distances as non-conformity measures and scaling the corresponding non-conformity scores through a learned prediction difficulty estimator. This yields locally adaptive, input-dependent prediction regions that respect the underlying manifold geometry, while retaining the finite-sample marginal coverage guarantee of split conformal prediction under exchangeability. We evaluate several Grassmannian distance metrics and compare their prediction-region efficiency on synthetic benchmarks and an airfoil inverse shape-design problem. The results highlight the advantages of geometry-aware non-conformity scores, while local adaptation improves empirical coverage uniformity across prediction difficulty levels

translated_title: 格拉斯曼流形上的自适应保形预测
translated_abstract: 我们为格拉斯曼值响应的回归问题引入了一个保形预测框架。所提出的方法直接在格拉斯曼流形上以度量球的形式构建预测区域，使用基不变的几何距离作为非一致性度量，并通过学习到的预测难度估计器对相应的非一致性分数进行缩放。这产生了局部自适应、依赖输入的预测区域，这些区域尊重底层流形几何结构，同时在可交换性假设下保留了分裂保形预测的有限样本边际覆盖保证。我们评估了几种格拉斯曼距离度量，并在合成基准和翼型逆向形状设计问题上比较了它们的预测区域效率。结果凸显了几何感知非一致性分数的优势，同时局部自适应提高了不同预测难度级别下的经验覆盖均匀性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个在格拉斯曼流形上构建局部自适应预测区域的保形预测框架，通过基不变的几何距离和学习到的难度估计器实现几何感知的非一致性度量，在保持有限样本覆盖保证的同时提升了不同难度下的覆盖均匀性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a conformal prediction framework on the Grassmann manifold that constructs locally adaptive prediction regions using basis-invariant geometric distances and a learned difficulty estimator, achieving geometry-aware non-conformity measures while retaining finite-sample coverage guarantees.
